svg.title: vLLM serving path: API server, EngineCore, GPU
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing a client request entering the API server process (FastAPI app and AsyncLLM), crossing ZMQ into the EngineCore process where the Scheduler and the Worker loop every step, and the Worker running forward and sampling on the GPU, with results returning along dashed arrows.
